description: Create a new appointment group (sign-up slots) in Canvas Scheduler. Provide at least one context_code (e.g. "course_123") and a title. Add new_appointments as [start_at, end_at] pairs to define time slots.

context_codes.description: Contexts to associate with this group, e.g. ["course_123"]

max_appointments_per_participant.description: Maximum time slots each participant can reserve

min_appointments_per_participant.description: Minimum time slots each participant must reserve

new_appointments.description: Time slots to create as [start_at, end_at] pairs (ISO 8601 strings)

participant_type.description: Whether individuals (User) or groups (Group) sign up. Default: User

participant_visibility.description: Who can see other sign-ups: "private" (instructors only) or "protected" (all participants)

publish.description: If true, publish immediately (default: false = draft)

name: create_appointment_group
title: Create Appointment Group
